run_streaming_reasoning_chat: run the python main function to stream chat completions with reasoning from a vLLM reasoning model
create_openai_client_for_vllm: create an OpenAI client pointing to a local vLLM API server at localhost port 8000
list_available_models: list available models from the vLLM server using the OpenAI client models list endpoint
stream_chat_completion_chunks: stream chat completion chunks with reasoning and content from a reasoning model using the OpenAI client
extract_reasoning_and_content_from_delta: extract reasoning and content attributes from a chat completion chunk delta using getattr with safe defaults
